entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Head coach Shane Steichen said Sunday that he doesn't expect Pierce (ankle) to return during joint practices leading up to the Colts' second preseason game against the Falcons on Saturday, so Pierce will have missed all of training camp, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: The Dolphins reinstated Bell (knee) from the non-football injury list Monday.

entries.name: George Kittle
entries.summary: Kittle (Achilles) said Sunday that he's "very confident" he won't start the season on the reserve/PUP list and that he's still got a chance to play Week 1 versus the Rams, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Josh Kattus
entries.summary: The Bengals activated Kattus (undisclosed) off the active/non-football injury list Thursday.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: The Bills placed Shavers (knee) on the active/PUP list Tuesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Charbonnet (knee) remains on the active/PUP list as the Seahawks' second preseason contest (Aug. 23 versus the Titans) approaches.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk (calf) is not suited up for Thursday's preseason opener against the Titans, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Darren Waller
entries.summary: The Panthers are slated to sign Waller (groin) to a one-year contract , Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling brought in seven of eight targets for 63 yards in the 49ers' 19-13 preseason loss to the Titans on Thursday.

entries.name: Gavin Bartholomew
entries.summary: Bartholomew saw one target in Saturday's preseason opener against the Giants.

entries.name: Jake Bobo
entries.summary: Bobo (hamstring) was a full participant in Monday's practice, Corbin K. Smith of SI.com reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Saturday that there is no timeline for Conner (foot) to participate in 11-on-11 drills in training camp practice, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: John Bates
entries.summary: Bates (hamstring) is set to begin practicing Tuesday, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

entries.name: Jordan James
entries.summary: James (ribs) will not play in Thursday's preseason opener against the Titans, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Kaelon Black
entries.summary: Black (thigh) will not play in Thursday's preseason opener against the Titans, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: KC Concepcion
entries.summary: Concepcion caught three of four targets for 27 yards and took his only carry 14 yards for a touchdown in Saturday's 34-10 preseason loss to the Bears.

entries.name: Makai Lemon
entries.summary: Lemon isn't suited up for Saturday's preseason game in Baltimore, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Nabers (knee) isn't in uniform for Saturday's preseason opener against Minnesota, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that Penix (knee) will remain limited to taking part in 7-on-7 drills during practices this week, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Patrick Mahomes
entries.summary: Mahomes (knee) won't play in Kansas City's preseason opener against the Rams on Saturday, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

entries.name: Sione Vaki
entries.summary: Vaki (nose) was a full participant in Sunday's practice, Dave Birkett of the Detroit Free Press reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Dell (knee) participated in "full-team drills" Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Tucker Kraft
entries.summary: Kraft said Sunday that he expects the Packers to limit his reps "probably until halfway through the season," Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Xavier Worthy
entries.summary: Worthy (shoulder) did not play in the Chiefs' 20-12 preseason loss to the Rams on Saturday.

entries.name: John Michael Gyllenborg
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Gyllenborg (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Ricky Pearsall
entries.summary: Pearsall announced Thursday in a post on his personal Instagram account that he underwent season-ending surgery to repair the PCL in his right knee, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.
